sentences.en: My school is getting ready for the campus music festival.
sentences.zh: 我们学校正在为校园音乐节做准备。

sentences.en: In Italy, each village holds a festival once a year.
sentences.zh: 在意大利，每个村庄每年都会举办一次节日。

sentences.en: That theater has a foreign film festival every other month.
sentences.zh: 那个剧院每隔一个月就会有一个外国电影节。

senses.zh: 节日；庆祝，纪念活动；欢乐
